reasons.eligible_first_child: Congratulations! You are eligible for ₹5,000 maternity benefit for your first child.
reasons.eligible_second_child_girl: Congratulations! You are eligible for ₹6,000 full maternity benefit as the second child is a girl.
reasons.ineligible_not_pregnant_lactating: This scheme is only for pregnant women and lactating mothers.
reasons.ineligible_second_child_boy: As per rules, second child benefit is available only when the second child is a girl.
reasons.ineligible_govt_employee: Government or PSU employees are not eligible as they receive separate maternity leave benefits.
reasons.ineligible_no_category: At least one qualifying category (e.g., ration card, E-Shram, MGNREGA, etc.) is required.
